{{Quote|I can take control of the upper level security droids. Override their programming.|Chaney Barrow|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Chaney Barrow''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] and computer expert living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She was motivated by greed and known to hold grudges. Formerly a top saboteur of the [[Exchange]] crime syndicate, she was captured and imprisoned in the [[Belsavis prison]] by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Invasion of Belsavis]] around [[3641 BBY]] she was sprung out of her cell along with three other prisoners - [[Kanjon Slyke]], [[Ohta]] and [[Paarkos]]. Their rescuer posed as a fellow inmate, but was in fact [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] operative [[Cipher Nine]]. The prisoners released were chosen for their skills and were asked to provide means to break into the [[Megasecurity Ward 23]]. To avoid the attention of [[SCORPIO]]'s security system, they came up with a plan to reprogram security droids and order them to cause havoc, thus triggering multiple alarms at different locations at once, overloading SCORPIO's capabilities. The plan eventually worked, though SCORPIO managed to disconnect herself from the network and upload her consciousness back into the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] body. During the infiltration Barrow was betrayed and shot by Slyke.

==Behind the scenes==
Barrow is killed by Slyke in the Dark Side option if the player does not intervene. She survives in the Light Side option.
